name: Edit
description:
Find-and-replace edits on a single file (one or many).

Detailed guide: ToolSearch{"query":"select:Edit"}

old_string.description: Literal text to find. Must match exactly.

replace_all.description:
false (default) requires `old_string` to occur exactly once; true
replaces every occurrence.

edits.description:
Edits applied atomically, in order, each to the result of the one
before. When given, the top-level `old_string` / `new_string` /
`replace_all` are ignored. If any edit fails, nothing is written.

file_path.description:
The absolute path to the file to edit. Relative paths are resolved
against the current working directory.

new_string.description: Single edit: the replacement; must differ from `old_string`.

old_string.description:
Single edit (when `edits` is absent): the literal text to find,
matched exactly, whitespace included.

replace_all.description:
Single edit: false (default) requires `old_string` to occur exactly
once; true replaces every occurrence.

name: EnterPlanMode
description: Enter plan mode to design before implementing

name: ExitPlanMode
description: Exit plan mode with plan summary and permission requests

name: Glob
description:
Find files by glob pattern (e.g. src/**/*.rs).

Detailed guide: ToolSearch{"query":"select:Glob"}

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 1000.

path.description: Root directory to search; defaults to the current working directory.

respect_gitignore.description: When false, include files ignored by .gitignore. Default true.

name: GoalCreate
description: Set a goal that keeps this session working across automatic rounds until it is complete. Use it when the user's request is a long-running objective that one turn won't finish, even if they don't say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

name: GoalGet
description: Read this session's goal, including the id and revision GoalUpdate needs.

name: GoalUpdate
description: Change this session's goal: edit, pause, resume, complete or blocked. Mark complete only when the whole objective is achieved; difficulty or remaining work is not blocked.

description:

Detailed guide: ToolSearch{"query":"select:Grep"}

glob.description: Glob filter restricting which files to search (e.g. "*.rs").

head_limit.description: Cap output lines; default 250 in content mode.

line_numbers.description: Prefix each line with its line number (content mode only).

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and ^/$ match line boundaries.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to search for (Rust regex syntax).

name: Monitor
description: Start a background script that streams stdout lines as events.

name: Read
description:
Read a file (text/image/PDF) with optional line range.

Detailed guide: ToolSearch{"query":"select:Read"}

file_path.description:
The absolute path to the file to read. Relative paths are resolved
against the current working directory.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read. Default 2000.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed). Default 1.

pages.description:
PDF page range (e.g., "1-5", "3"). Max 20 pages per request.
Only applicable to PDF files.

name: RunCode
description:
Run a JavaScript program that calls this session's tools — in parallel, in loops or in stages — and get back only its return value. For batch work (many files, pages or items) and for workflows or multi-agent orchestration: agent(prompt, {type, schema}) starts a sub-agent. For a single task or a few calls, call the tools directly.

A script (QuickJS, ES2023, top-level await; no require/import or Node/browser APIs). tools.<Name>(input) and callTool(name, input) return Promises that reject on failure; log(text) reports progress. End with `return <JSON value>`.

Callable here (MCP tools too, with callTool; the guide has the rest):
  tools.Bash({command, description?, timeout_ms?}) → {stdout, stderr, exit_code}; a non-zero exit rejects with the output
  tools.Edit({edits?, file_path, new_string?, old_string?, replace_all?})
  tools.Glob({max_results?, path?, pattern, respect_gitignore?}) → {paths: string[], more: number} — newest first; more counts what max_results cut
  tools.Grep({case_insensitive?, glob?, head_limit?, line_numbers?, multiline?, output_mode?, path?, pattern}) → files_with_matches (default): {files: string[]}; count: {counts: {path: n}}; content: text, one 'path:line' match per line
  tools.Read({file_path, limit?, offset?, pages?}) → text, each line prefixed with its number and a tab
  tools.WebFetch({prompt?, url})
  tools.WebSearch({allowed_domains?, blocked_domains?, max_results?, query})
  tools.Write({content, file_path})

Detailed guide: ToolSearch{"query":"select:RunCode"}

background.description:

code.description:
The JavaScript program. End it with `return <JSON value>`; that value
is the result.

description.description: One line saying what the program does, shown in the task list.

name: TaskMessage

name: TaskOutput

name: TaskStop
description: Stop a running background task by ID

name: TaskWait
description: Wait for any or all of several background tasks to end

name: TodoWrite
description: Maintain a structured task list for the current turn.

name: ToolSearch
description:
A tool listed with an empty input schema is deferred: fetch its schema here before calling it. Returns the schema in a <functions> block, and a tool's detailed usage guide when it has one. Query "select:A,B" for known names, or keywords to search ("+term" must appear in the name).

Detailed guide: ToolSearch{"query":"select:ToolSearch"}

query.description:
`select:<name>[,<name>...]` to fetch known tools by name; otherwise
keywords to search tool names and descriptions, where `+term` must
appear in the name.
